item.description: GUWAHATI: The installation of overhead canopy bridges along a state highway in Assam’s Kokrajhar district has led to a significant reduction in road accidents involving the endangered golden langur, according to a recent study. item.title: Youth Hurt in Guwahati's Ganeshguri Road Accident Succumbs to Injuries
item.description: GUWAHATI: A youth, who was critically injured in a road accident in Guwahati’s Ganeshguri area in the early hours of Friday, December 26, succumbed to his injuries while undergoing treatment at a hospital on Saturday. The deceased has been identified as Rishab Bajoria, a resident of Machkhowa. item.title: GMC Fines Business in Lokhra ₹1 Lakh for Operating Without Valid Trade Licence
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Guwahati Municipal Corporation (GMC) has imposed a fine of ₹1 lakh on a business establishment in Lokhra for operating without a valid trade licence. The action was taken in Ward No. 23 as part of GMC’s ongoing enforcement drive against violations of municipal regulations. item.title: Guwahati Hosts Launch of Debut Historical Fiction Anthology "Colour My Grave Purple"
item.description: Guwahati witnessed the launch of debut author Shehnab Sahin’s first book, Colour My Grave Purple, published by Niyogi Books under its English fiction imprint, Olive Turtle. The book, an anthology of 10 historical fiction stories, traces Assam’s socio-cultural and political journey across more than a century, spanning from 1858 to 2019. item.title: Deepti Sharma Becomes Third-Highest Wicket-Taker in Women’s International Cricket; First Indian to Reach 150-Mark in T20
item.description: GUWAHATI: India all-rounder Deepti Sharma has registered multiple milestones during the third T20 International against Sri Lanka, moving to third place on the list of highest wicket-takers in women’s international cricket. The spell also saw Deepti become the first Indian cricketer, across both men’s and women’s formats, to reach 150 wickets in T20 Internationals. item.title: PAN–Aadhaar Linking Deadline Set for December 31; Inoperative Status Looms for Non-Compliant Holders
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Income Tax Department has issued a renewed reminder to all Permanent Account Number holders to link their PAN with Aadhaar before the stipulated deadline of December 31. Failure to complete the linking process within the prescribed timeline will result in the PAN becoming inoperative, impacting multiple tax-related services.
